manifestDescription: Retain rendered PDF pages and reduce redraws when returning to a paper.
intro: Keep rendered PDF pages in memory to reduce waiting when returning to a paper.
enabledHelp: Protect page canvases from cleanup triggered by hiding the reader, switching desktops, or switching tabs.
tabsLabel: Also prevent automatic PDF tab unloading
tabsHelp: Keep loaded PDF tabs available when reading several papers. Manually closing a tab still releases its resources.
cacheLabel: Retain rendered pages as you read (uses more memory)
cacheHelp: Pages render as you read. Retain completed page canvases for reuse when revisiting earlier pages or returning to the paper.
preloadLabel: Preload the entire PDF after opening (renders every page; uses more memory)
preloadHelp: Actively render every page at the current zoom and retain its canvas. Visible pages take priority; other pages render in turn without moving your reading position.
settingsHelp: Settings apply immediately and persist after restarting. Turn off the master switch or disable the plugin to restore Zotero’s normal behavior.
inheritHelp: Open any previously unloaded PDF tab once. Page retention applies to currently loaded PDFs and preserves the corresponding checkbox choice from version 1.1.
releaseHelp: Turning page retention off restores normal cleanup of distant pages. Closing a paper releases its resources.
scaleHelp: Caches follow the current zoom and document state. Zooming, rotating, or editing a PDF can require pages to be drawn again.
compatHelp: Targets Zotero 10.0.6. Both versions have user-reported working operation on macOS 27.0.1.
preloadUsage: Whole-PDF preloading is off by default. Enabling it also processes loaded PDFs. Status shows completed page canvases, summed across loaded papers.
preloadReleaseHelp: Preloading retains completed canvases. Turning preloading off stops further proactive renders. If page retention remains on, existing canvases stay cached. With both options off, normal cleanup resumes.
preloadCostHelp: Initial preloading and rendering at a new zoom increase processing work. Completed canvases remain available for later reading. Closing a paper releases its resources.
notRunning: The plugin is not running. Enable it under Tools → Plugins.
disabledStatus: Off · Using Zotero’s normal cache cleanup and tab unloading
cachePreload: Page cache: retained by whole-PDF preloading
failedDocuments: · {count} document(s) could not start; see diagnostics
errorOpen: Zotero.Reader.open is unavailable; newly opened PDFs may not be protected automatically.
errorTabs: The automatic tab unloading interface is unavailable; page cache protection remains available.
errorCacheMissing: The page retention component is unavailable.
errorVisibility: The reader does not expose the expected visibility interface; it was left unchanged.
errorView: The primary PDF reading view could not be found.
errorViewer: The PDF viewer’s page retention interface is unavailable.
errorPreloadMissing: The PDF pre-rendering component is unavailable.
errorRenderAPI: The reader’s PDF page rendering interface is unavailable.
errorPage: PDF page {page} could not be preloaded: {error}
